qualifier: enteric nervous system and arterial regulation
name: Endothelin signaling in enteric innervation and arterial regulation
rationale: All members concern endothelin receptor signaling and its roles in enteric neural crest development, gut motility and arterial morphogenesis/pressure, which separates it from RET/GDNF, catecholaminergic and gastrointestinal smooth-muscle neighbours.

qualifier: metanephric mesenchyme epithelialization and tubule formation
name: Metanephric mesenchyme epithelialization and early nephron tubule formation
rationale: Members cover metanephric mesenchyme maintenance, differentiation and mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition into renal vesicles and tubules (with nephric duct and ureteric bud elongation), unlike neighbours focused on nephron segment patterning, ureteric bud induction or negative regulation of kidney growth.

qualifier: LXR and SREBP transcriptional control
name: LXR and SREBP control of triglyceride and gluconeogenic metabolism
rationale: Members are LXR/SREBP-driven gene expression and regulation of triglyceride synthesis, lipolysis, fatty acid homeostasis and gluconeogenesis, distinct from PPARG adipogenesis, PPARA/PGC-1alpha nuclear receptor programs and glucagon/PKA signaling neighbours.

qualifier: EGFR and ERBB2 adaptor and effector events
name: EGFR and ERBB2 signaling effector events
rationale: All members are EGFR or ERBB2 signaling steps through GRB2, SHC1, GRB7, GAB1, PLCG1, PI3K and PTK6, whereas the confusables center on ERBB3 and ERBB4 signaling.

qualifier: axon regeneration, collateral sprouting and myelination
name: Axon regeneration, collateral sprouting and myelination
rationale: Members combine regulation of axon regeneration and collateral sprouting (including axonal growth inhibition/stimulation) with CNS and PNS myelin formation and maintenance and glial responses, setting it apart from nodal-domain, Sema3A axon-guidance and glial-fate neighbours.

qualifier: skeletal muscle and neuromuscular junction
name: Laminin basement membrane in muscle and neuromuscular junction
rationale: Members are basement membrane assembly, laminin/collagen/proteoglycan interactions and their use in skeletal muscle (dystrophin-glycoprotein complex, myogenesis) and neuromuscular junction assembly, unlike hemidesmosome or fibrillar collagen ECM neighbours.

qualifier: G1/S transition and replication origin licensing
name: E2F-driven G1/S transition and DNA replication origin licensing
rationale: Members are E2F target programs, proliferating-cell cycle modules and ORC/CDC6/pre-replicative complex assembly and replication initiation, distinct from DREAM-mediated repression, G2/M checkpoint and DNA repair-replication neighbours.

qualifier: AMP and IMP degradation via inosine
name: Purine ribonucleotide catabolism via inosine
rationale: All members describe breakdown of AMP, IMP and purine ribonucleosides through inosine, unlike neighbours concerned with purine salvage or deoxyribonucleotide metabolism.

qualifier: guanine-N7 methylation
name: tRNA and guanine-N7 RNA methylation
rationale: Members concern methylation of tRNA, including guanine-N7 methylation, and regulation of tRNA metabolism, unlike pseudouridylation, mitochondrial RNA processing or aminoacylation neighbours.

qualifier: oligosaccharide assembly and elongation enzymes
name: Congenital N-glycosylation disorders of oligosaccharide assembly enzymes
rationale: All members are inherited defects in N-glycan precursor assembly (ALG enzymes, DPAGT1, RFT1, dolichol and mannose supply) and Golgi N-glycan elongation, distinct from neighbours on dolichyl-phosphate mannose synthase, PGM1 and GPI-anchor defects.

qualifier: nodal sodium channel clustering
name: L1-family adhesion and nodal sodium channel clustering
rationale: Members are L1, CHL1, NrCAM, neurofascin and NCAM1 interactions together with paranodal assembly, sodium channel clustering and action potential propagation, unlike myelination, gap junction or DSCAM/nectin adhesion neighbours.

qualifier: alpha-, beta- and omega-oxidation with hereditary neurometabolic defects
name: Fatty acid alpha-, beta-, omega-oxidation and hereditary neurometabolic defects
rationale: Members are peroxisomal alpha/beta and omega oxidation of fatty acids plus inherited defects (ALD, CTX, spastic paraplegias) in lipid-oxidizing enzymes and transporters, distinct from peroxisome biogenesis, lipid synthesis and bile acid neighbours.

qualifier: RHO- and CDC42-subfamily GTPases with formin and IQGAP effectors
name: RHO- and CDC42-family GTPase cycles via formins and IQGAPs
rationale: Members are GTPase cycles of RHOA-D, CDC42, RHOJ/U/V, RHOG and RAC3 with formin and IQGAP effectors and focal adhesion disassembly, unlike RAC1/RAC2-WAVE lamellipodia or RND neighbours.

qualifier: FGFR1 and FGFR2 isoform ligand binding and activating mutants
name: FGFR1 and FGFR2 isoform ligand binding and activating mutants
rationale: All members concern ligand binding/activation of FGFR1 and FGFR2 splice isoforms and their activating mutants, distinct from downstream FRS/SHC/PLC cascades and FGFR3/FGFR4 neighbours.

qualifier: glial fate specification and oligodendrocyte differentiation
name: Glial fate specification, proliferation and oligodendrocyte differentiation
rationale: Members are glial fate specification, glial and oligodendrocyte progenitor proliferation, astrocyte and oligodendrocyte differentiation and CNS myelination control, unlike axon regeneration, nodal domain or Schwann cell myelination neighbours.

qualifier: biogenesis and RISC assembly
name: MicroRNA biogenesis and RISC-mediated silencing
rationale: Members cover miRNA processing, RISC assembly and small-RNA silencing, distinct from neighbours on miRNA turnover, mRNA decay and target-specific translational control.

qualifier: adenylate cyclase control of growth hormone secretion
name: Peptide GPCR adenylate cyclase signaling controlling growth hormone secretion
rationale: Members are glucagon-family and somatostatin receptor signaling acting on adenylate cyclase and growth hormone secretion, unlike insulin-secretion, GH receptor and feeding-behaviour neighbours.

qualifier: glycinergic inhibitory transmission
name: Glycinergic inhibitory transmission and locomotor coordination
rationale: Members combine glycinergic transmission (including GlyT2 hyperekplexia) with locomotion, proprioception, righting reflex and Purkinje layer formation, unlike cerebellar granule, exploratory or vocal behaviour neighbours; one neural RNA-binding module fits loosely.

qualifier: scavenger receptors and apoptotic cell efferocytosis
name: Scavenger receptor uptake and apoptotic cell efferocytosis
rationale: Members are class A/B/F/H scavenger receptor uptake and recognition, phosphatidylserine exposure and engulfment of apoptotic cells, distinct from oxLDL/foam cell, microglial activation and lipid scrambling neighbours.

qualifier: metalloproteinases and hyaluronan catabolism
name: Extracellular matrix degradation by metalloproteinases and hyaluronidases
rationale: Members are collagen, elastin and hyaluronan catabolism, MMP activation and protease/inhibitor regulation, unlike neighbours on ECM synthesis/crosslinking or fibrinolysis.

core: Nucleotide and nucleoside transport and interconversion
qualifier: mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange and phosphocreatine phosphotransfer
name: Nucleoside transport, mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange and phosphotransfer
rationale: Members cover plasma-membrane nucleoside/nucleobase transport (and nucleoside-analog drugs), mitochondrial adenine nucleotide exchange and NDP/NTP and creatine phosphotransfer, unlike NUDT/thiopurine, NAD and xenobiotic-efflux neighbours.

qualifier: UV and oxidative stress induction
name: UV- and oxidative stress-induced premature senescence
rationale: Members are UV response programs and stress-induced premature senescence with its p53/stress-kinase regulation, distinct from oncogene-induced, replicative senescence, SASP and apoptosis neighbours.

qualifier: scaRNA and telomerase RNA
name: Cajal body targeting of scaRNA and telomerase RNA
rationale: Members concern localizing scaRNAs, telomerase RNA and proteins to Cajal bodies and RNA folding, unlike neighbours on RNA modification or telomere extension.

qualifier: RIPK1-mediated signaling and microbial modulation
name: Necroptosis signaling and its microbial modulation
rationale: Members are necroptotic signaling and its regulation, including microbial and SARS-CoV-1 modulation of RIPK1 necrosis, distinct from death-receptor caspase-8 apoptosis and apoptotic execution neighbours.

qualifier: collateral sprouting and chemorepulsion
name: Regulation of axon extension and collateral sprouting during guidance
rationale: Members are positive and negative regulation of axon extension during guidance, chemorepulsion and collateral sprouting, without the netrin- or Sema3A-specific signaling that defines the neighbours.
